trigger: Ensemble mandatory finding: six numbered Third stages substitute withholding/unknown content for speech-act selection.
method_chain: private appraisal -> communicative objective -> speech act -> relationship/role constraint -> register -> surface wording
scope: Six pipeline paragraph fragments and six inclusive claim hash values only. Locally supported acts already existed in the declared models; no new source, psychology, lexical catalog, ceiling, metadata, QA or prediction revision.

entries.exact_old_text: First fix the local knowledge and whether private appraisal is available. Second choose the communicative objective: open mediation, report evidence, avoid unnecessary political commitment, or move a threatened command. Third preserve withheld content: V06 has no direct private opinion to disclose.
entries.exact_new_text: First fix the local knowledge and whether private appraisal is available; V06 private opinion remains unavailable as an appraisal and objective limit. Second choose the communicative objective: open mediation, convey bounded evidence, avoid unnecessary political commitment or get a threatened command moving. Third select the speech act for that objective: proposal, qualified apology/interruption, evidence report, deliberate non-answer, urgent warning/request or subordinate instruction.
